page.overview:
Who is Ewald Boisitz?

Ewald Boisitz (born 20 November 1945 and died 30 September 1979) was an Austrian racing driver, who was entered in the second car at his home event in . However, he did not have the required funding to race and was withdrawn.

Boisitz began is racing career competing in touring cars in the 1960s. Despite a brief venture into the European Touring Car Championship in 1969, he primarily raced in Austrian events.

In 1975, he secured a drive with Surtees for the Austrian Grand Prix and was entered into the race. However, he failed to secure the funding originally promised to the Surtees team and was ultimately withdrawn from the race.

He continued racing, although never on the international scale. He was killed in a car accident at the age of 33.
